response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageListPrice, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name;

assumptions.assumption: Large files are strictly larger than 10323804 bytes.

alternatives.interpretation: If the threshold is inclusive, keep files of at least 10323804 bytes.
